remarks: Convenience & sophisticated style is what you get with this luxury 2 bedroom + Den, 1.5 bathroom home set back on quiet cul-de-sac near the beach. Enjoy the open floor plan featuring a beautiful kitchen with custom cabinetry, granite countertops and stainless steel appliances that opens up to the dining room and living room. Walk out to your sprawling deck overlooking the perfectly manicured private fenced in back yard creating an amazing indoor/outdoor living experience. Recess lights, hardwood floors and lots of storage throughout. Upper level features large bedroom, den, full bathroom, and spectacular primary bedroom. Enjoy the full size basement with perfect for media room, gym, 2nd office or storage. Perfectly located minutes from Chelsea Piers, Beaches, Parks, I-95, and Shopping.
